description: Human-review queue for legal-resource candidates discovered by the PNG Legal Library automation.
usage_notes: Discovery does not establish authenticity, legal effect, current legal status, or redistribution rights.
Review the source identity and individual resource before approving a candidate.
Verify legal status using appropriate evidence before recording a resource as in force.
Check redistribution permission before storing or distributing a document copy.
When permission is unknown, retain the source link and permitted metadata instead of assuming copying is allowed.
Do not add personal, confidential, or completed case documents.
Keep rejected and duplicate records distinguishable from approved records.
Only approved candidates may be considered for transfer to data/legal-resources.json.
